video_caption: The video begins with an animated logo for "TV CLACSO" (TV CLACSO), "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences), featuring a retro TV icon. This transitions into an animation that resembles pages turning in a book, displaying various interconnected concepts like "CONTRACULTURA" (Counterculture), "CULTURA" (Culture), "CIENCIAS" (Sciences), "CAPITALISMO" (Capitalism), "CONTRAHEGEMONÍA" (Counter-hegemony), "CIUDADANÍA" (Citizenship), and a map of Latin America with "COMUNIDAD" (Community), "COOPERACIÓN" (Cooperation), "CONEXIÓN" (Connection). The animation then shows two head outlines facing each other with "CRÍTICA" (Criticism) and "CONSTRUCCIÓN" (Construction) between them, followed by jagged lines forming around the words "CRISIS" (Crisis) and "CAOS" (Chaos). Further animated pages display a list of concepts such as "CAPACIDAD" (Capacity), "COYUNTURA" (Juncture), "COLONIALIDAD" (Coloniality), "COLECTIVO" (Collective), "COMPROMISO" (Commitment), "CIVILIZACIÓN" (Civilization), "CONSTITUYENTE" (Constituent), "CONSIGNA" (Slogan), "COMPLEJIDAD" (Complexity), "CLASE" (Class), and a circular network of words like "CONFLICTO" (Conflict), "CONTRAPODER" (Counterpower), "CONOCIMIENTO" (Knowledge), "CONCIENCIA" (Consciousness), "CLANDESTINIDAD" (Clandestinity), "COMUNICACIÓN" (Communication), "COLONIZACIÓN" (Colonization), "CONTRADICCIÓN" (Contradiction), "CREATIVIDAD" (Creativity). The animation concludes with "Un programa del CLACSO" (A program of CLACSO), showing the Latin American map again, and "conducido por Martín Granovsky" (hosted by Martín Granovsky), before reverting to the initial "C" network logo. The scene then cuts to an indoor interview setting where a man with a beard and a brown plaid jacket sits in a black leather armchair, speaking and gesturing with his hands. A small microphone is clipped to his shirt. The back of another person, wearing a black top, is partially visible to his left. In the background, a long conference table with microphones and water bottles can be seen, along with a banner for "FLACSO ARGENTINA" (Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences, Argentina) and a CLACSO TV logo in the top right corner.

The video opens with a medium shot of a man with a beard, wearing a plaid jacket over a white shirt and dark pants, seated in a black armchair. His hands are clasped in front of him as he speaks, looking towards an unseen interviewer whose back of the head and shoulder are visible on the left. Behind the man is a long wooden table with microphones, water bottles, and a white projector. A blue banner stands behind him on the right, displaying "FLACSO ARGENTINA" and "Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales, Sede Argentina" (Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences, Argentina Headquarters), along with a website address. In the top right corner, a red logo with "TV CLACSO" (TV CLACSO) and "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences) is visible.

A light-skinned woman with blonde hair, wearing a white button-up shirt, a black cardigan, and a turquoise and silver beaded necklace, is seated in a dark chair and speaking, looking slightly to her right. A small black microphone is clipped to her cardigan. In the soft-focus background, several people are visible: a man in a suit jacket seated to her left, a man with a beard in a dark sweater seated behind her, two women standing further back, and a man in a dark suit holding a blue folder on the far right. The setting appears to be an indoor space with rows of dark, empty chairs and large windows in the background. In the upper right corner, a TV channel logo displays "TV CLACSO" with a globe icon, and below it, in smaller text, "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences).

The video segment opens with a medium shot of a bearded man in a brown plaid jacket and white shirt, seated in a black leather armchair, speaking to an unseen interviewer. His hands are clasped in front of him, and a microphone is clipped to his shirt. In the background, a long wooden table with microphones, a white flag with a blue emblem, and a blue banner displaying "FLACSO ARGEN" (Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales, Sede Argentina, www.flacso.org.ar) are visible, indicating an academic setting. The camera then cuts to a blonde woman wearing a white shirt, black cardigan, and a distinctive necklace, also seated in a black chair, speaking and smiling with a microphone clipped to her. Empty chairs are arranged in rows behind her, with other blurred individuals present in the background, including a man with a beard and another in a suit, suggesting a conference or lecture hall. The video frequently alternates between these two speakers, always showing a TV CLASSCO logo (Televisión Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales) in the top right corner. The man mentions "counter-power," and the woman responds, "I mean, it's wanting to be one."

The video segment features a blonde-haired woman and a man with a beard, both seated and being interviewed in what appears to be a conference room or lecture hall. The woman, wearing a white shirt, a black cardigan, and a multi-colored beaded necklace, smiles and speaks directly into a microphone clipped to her shirt, often gesturing with her hands. The man, dressed in a brown checkered blazer, a white shirt, and dark pants, also speaks while making hand gestures, with a microphone clipped to his shirt. In the background, during the shots of the woman, there are rows of empty black chairs, with a few other individuals dimly visible, standing and sitting further back. During the shots of the man, a banner behind him displays "FLACSO ARGEN" (Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales - Sede Argentina) and the CLACSO logo. Both shots consistently feature a "TV CLACSO" (Television CLACSO) logo in the upper right corner, indicating the media outlet. The video alternates between close-up shots of the woman and the man, highlighting their discussion.

The video opens with a fair-haired woman, identified by an on-screen graphic as "Karen Smith | Sudáfrica (South Africa) University of Capetown," sitting in a black chair and speaking, with a microphone clipped to her black cardigan and a teal beaded necklace. She is in a room with rows of black chairs, some occupied by other individuals in the background, including a man in a suit, another man looking at his phone, and a woman in a pink top. The room has large windows on the left, and a "TV CLACSO" logo is visible in the top right corner. The scene then cuts to a bearded man in a brown checkered jacket and white shirt, sitting in a black chair and speaking, with his hands clasped. He is in a different room, with a long table, microphones, a flag, and a blue banner with "FLACSO ARGEN" and "Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales" visible behind him. The "TV CLACSO" logo remains in the top right. The video then cuts back to the woman speaking in the first room, with the "TV CLACSO" logo present, which momentarily changes to a colorful animated logo before reverting.

The video segment features an interview, primarily showing a blonde woman identified by an on-screen graphic as Karen Smith from Sudáfrica (South Africa), University of Capetown. She is seated in a black chair, wearing a white blouse, a black cardigan, and a colorful beaded necklace, speaking into a lapel microphone. Her expression is engaged as she looks slightly off-camera. Behind her, rows of empty black chairs are visible, along with several individuals in the background, some seated and others standing, indicating a conference or lecture hall setting with natural light streaming through large windows. Briefly, at the 0:06 mark, the scene cuts to a bearded man, dressed in a brown plaid jacket, also seated in a black chair with a lapel microphone, clasping his hands and looking to his left. He is in a different room, possibly within the same institution, with a wall displaying a crest or logo and text that reads "FLACSO ARGEN," "Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales," "Sede Argentina," and "www.flacso.org" (Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences, Argentina Chapter). Both frames feature a "TV CLACSO" logo in the top right corner.

The video segment features two individuals, a man and a woman, speaking in what appears to be a conference or academic setting. The man, wearing a white shirt and a plaid blazer, sits in a black armchair with his hands clasped, speaking with a engaged expression. Behind him, a long table with microphones and water bottles is visible, along with a banner that partially shows "FLACSO ARGEN" (likely "FLACSO Argentina," referring to the Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences) and a flag. The woman, with blonde hair, a white blouse, black cardigan, and a multi-colored beaded necklace, is also seated in a black armchair, speaking and smiling pleasantly, with a small microphone clipped to her blouse. Behind her, several other people are seated in black chairs, forming an audience, some observing, others talking amongst themselves. A man in a suit is standing in the far background. Throughout the segment, a "TV CLACSO" (Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales - Latin American Council of Social Sciences) logo is present in the top right corner, occasionally changing its visual style. From 0:24 onwards, a lower third graphic identifies the woman as "Karen Smith | Sudáfrica (South Africa) | University of Capetown." The video alternates between close-ups of the man and the woman as they speak, with the audience visible in the background when the woman is shown.

The video segment opens with a blonde woman wearing a white shirt, black cardigan, and a beaded necklace, seated on the left in a black chair, speaking with an engaged expression. A small lavalier microphone is clipped to her shirt. In the background, several individuals are seated in rows of black chairs, with some standing further back near large windows. A "TV CLACSO" logo, with the text "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences), is visible in the top right corner. The scene then cuts to a bearded man in a plaid jacket and white shirt, also with a microphone, sitting on the right in a black chair, looking left and speaking thoughtfully, with his hands clasped. Behind him, a blue and white flag hangs next to a banner displaying "FLACSO ARGEN" (Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales, Argentina) and the website "www.flacso.org.ar". A projector sits on a table to the left. The "CLACSO" logo in the corner briefly changes to a colorful animated version. The video then cuts back to the blonde woman, continuing her speech, with the background and "TV CLACSO" logo returning to their initial appearances.

The video segment opens with a blonde woman, Karen Smith from the University of Capetown, Sudáfrica (South Africa), speaking while seated in an auditorium-like setting. She wears a white shirt, black cardigan, and a multi-colored beaded necklace, with a microphone clipped to her shirt. She looks slightly to her right, her expression engaged as she talks. In the background, other people are seated in rows of chairs. A banner in the top right corner displays "TV CLACSO" (TV CLACSO) with "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences) underneath. The scene then transitions to a bearded man wearing a white shirt and a checkered blazer, sitting in a black armchair and gesturing with his hands as he speaks to someone off-camera. Behind him is a long table with microphones and water bottles, and a blue and white banner that reads "FLACSO ARGEN" (FLACSO Argentina) and "Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences). The "CLACSO" logo is visible in the top right corner of this shot as well.

The video segment features a conversational exchange between a woman and a man, alternating between close-up shots of each speaker. The woman, with blonde hair, is wearing a white shirt, a black cardigan, and a turquoise necklace, speaking into a lapel microphone and gesturing with her hands. The man, with short brown hair and a beard, is wearing a checkered jacket and dark pants, also speaking into a lapel microphone and using hand gestures. In the background when the man speaks, there's a long table with water bottles and microphones, and a banner for "FLACSO ARGEN" (Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales, Sede Argentina) and "www.flacso.org". When the woman speaks, she is in a different setting, with rows of empty chairs behind her and a few individuals in the background, suggesting a lecture hall or conference room. A text overlay appears at 0:23 to identify her as "Karen Smith | Sudáfrica University of Capetown" (Karen Smith | South Africa University of Capetown). Throughout the video, a "TV CLACSO" (Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales) logo is visible in the top right corner, sometimes animated with colorful dots.

The video segment features an interview taking place in what appears to be a conference room or lecture hall. A man with a beard, wearing a brown checkered jacket over a white shirt and dark pants, is seated in a black armchair on the right side of the frame, speaking and occasionally gesturing with his clasped hands. A small microphone is clipped to his shirt. He looks to his left, seemingly at the interviewer. A woman, the interviewer, is partially visible on the left side, seated in another black armchair. The camera frequently cuts between the man speaking and the woman, who has blonde hair tied back, wearing a white shirt under a black cardigan and a multi-colored (green, blue, white) beaded necklace, also with a microphone clipped to her shirt. She is seen smiling and speaking, at times gesturing with her right hand, while looking to her right, addressing the man. In the background of the woman's shots, several other people are seated in black chairs, observing the interview. The room has light-colored walls, large windows in the distance, and a long table with microphones and water bottles in the background behind the man. A blue banner with the text "FLACSO ARGEN" (Facultad Latinoamericana de Ciencias Sociales, Sede Argentina - Latin American Faculty of Social Sciences, Argentina Branch) and a website address "www.flac..." is visible behind the man, along with a coat of arms on the wall. A "TV CLACSO" (Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales - Latin American Council of Social Sciences) logo is displayed in the top right corner of the screen throughout the segment, sometimes accompanied by a colorful circular logo for CLACSO.

The video segment opens with a bearded man in a brown plaid jacket and white shirt sitting in a black leather armchair, smiling and speaking with his hands clasped, facing a woman whose back is visible in the foreground. Behind him, there's a long wooden table with microphones and water bottles, a light-colored wall adorned with a blue and white crest, and a blue banner partially reading "FLACSO ARGEN". A "TV CLACSO" logo is present in the top right corner. The scene then transitions to a blonde woman wearing a white shirt, a black cardigan, and a multi-colored beaded necklace, sitting in a black chair and speaking with a smile, while other individuals are seated in the blurred background. A white text box appears at the bottom, stating: "Karen Smith | Sudáfrica (South Africa) University of Capetown." A colorful circular CLACSO logo briefly appears and moves to the top right. The video then cuts back to the bearded man in the brown plaid jacket, still speaking and smiling in the black leather armchair, with the "TV CLACSO" logo returning to the top right.

The video opens with a blonde woman, Karen Smith from the University of Capetown, Sudáfrica (South Africa), speaking with a small microphone clipped to her white shirt. She is wearing a black cardigan and a turquoise necklace, sitting in a black armchair and looking towards the right side of the frame. Behind her, several people are seated and standing in a lecture hall with rows of dark chairs and large windows. The "TV CLACSO (Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales)" logo is visible in the top right corner. The scene then cuts to a bearded man in a brown checkered blazer and dark pants, also with a microphone, sitting in a black armchair and listening intently, with his hands clasped. In his background, a conference table with a projector and water bottles is visible, along with a banner partially reading "FLACSO ARGEN" and "Facultad Latinamericana de Ciencias Sociales Sede Argen". The video alternates between these two speakers, with the woman's name and affiliation displayed on a white banner at the bottom of the screen during her segments.

The video segment opens with an interview in a conference room setting, where two individuals are seated in black armchairs. On the right, a man with a light beard, wearing a light brown plaid blazer and a white collared shirt, sits with his hands clasped, speaking and smiling. Facing him, on the left, is a woman in a dark top, whose back is primarily visible to the camera. The background features a long table with microphones and water bottles, a white projector, and a blue banner partially displaying "FLACSO ARGENTINA." A flag, possibly Argentinian, is also visible. Throughout the interview, a "TV CLACSO" logo with the text "Consejo Latinoamericano de Ciencias Sociales" (Latin American Council of Social Sciences) is present in the top right corner, occasionally changing to a colorful abstract "CLACSO" logo. The camera alternates between close-ups of the man and the woman. When focused on the woman, identified later as Karen Smith, she is seen wearing a white blouse, a black cardigan, and a multi-colored beaded necklace, speaking and smiling, with rows of empty black chairs and other people in the background. At 0:30, a white text box appears at the bottom left of the screen, identifying her as "Karen Smith | Sudáfrica (South Africa) | University of Capetown." The man listens attentively, sometimes nodding, while Karen explains a policy. The segment concludes with a vintage television graphic appearing on a white background, displaying scrolling production credits in Spanish, including "Equipo de Producción: (Production Team:) Pablo Gentili, Fernanda Saforcada, Martin Granovsky, Alejandro Gambina, Gabriela Porta, Denis Nohemy Rojas Gómez, Pablo Vommaro, Lucas Sablich," "Títulos y textos: (Titles and texts:) Alejandro Gambina," "Streaming: Christian Iturricha," "Diseño gráfico: (Graphic design:) Marcelo Giardino," "Programación Web: (Web Programming:) Sebastián Higa," "Cámara, iluminación, sonido y postproducción: (Camera, lighting, sound and post-production:) Guido Ignacio Fontán," and "Conducción y Coordinador del Portal CLACSO.TV: (Conduction and Coordinator of CLACSO.TV Portal:) Martin Granovsky." Following the credits, an animated logo of rotating colorful circles appears, which then transforms into a stylized red "C" logo with the text "CLACSO" below it, and finally transitions into the "TV CLACSO" logo with its full name, signifying the end of the video.
